settings.hero_desc: A bold double-headed eagle emblem, sculpted and dramatically backlit so it glows from within, mounted on a sleek black plinth. A commanding illuminated art piece for lobbies, events and statement interiors - made to your emblem, crest or logo. You can control the LED lighting colour and animation with a remote.
settings.hspec1_v: 50 x 50 x 4 cm for Eagle, 80cm base height
settings.perso_placeholder: Your emblem/crest/logo, size, lighting colour and plinth
settings.s1_body: This sculpted eagle is lit from below so it radiates a warm glow, mounted on a tall black plinth for real presence. It makes a powerful centrepiece for a lobby, event or feature space - and we can build the same illuminated treatment for any emblem, national symbol, crest or company logo you choose.
settings.case_body: Built as an illuminated emblem display, this backlit eagle anchored the space with a dramatic glow - the kind of piece that draws every eye on entry. We recreate any emblem or logo with the same lit, plinth-mounted treatment.
settings.case_quote: The glow gives it real presence - it's the first thing everyone notices when they walk in.
settings.prov_p: An emblem in daylight is one thing; the same emblem glowing from within is another. Backlighting turns a symbol into a centrepiece that owns the room.
